newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - SEPT 5.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - SEPT 5.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- The Romanian government intends to deal with the issue of ethnic Hungarian church properties in Romania before the elections, the foreign ministry said in a letter to its Hungarian counterpart.
- Jozsef Torgyan, head of the opposition party Smallholders has challanged Prime Minister Gyula Horn for an open TV debate about the Hungarians' vital historic issues.
- Sandor Lezsak, head of opposition party Democratic Forum proposed he will issue a call for the next Hungarian-Hungarian summit for December.
- The Hungarian foreign ministry has no official information that a Bosnian-Serb summit will take place in Hungary.
- Mutual insurance - most of them pension funds - membership increases by 20,000 a month.
